text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
—All riiiight, I'm gonna get a solid 
night's sleep today~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
(All riiight, ready... go! —One sheep! Two 
sheep! Three sheep!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
(—100 sheep! 101 sheep! 102 sheep! Still 
gotta keep giving it my all~!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
(—10,000 sheep! 10,001 sheep! 10,002 
sheep—I'm okay! I can go so much 
further—!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, huh? It's bright... Morning? Is it 
morning already!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I blew it~...! I tried way too hard 
counting sheep~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the means and the end getting 
reversed, Machikane Tannhauser seems to 
have unintentionally pulled an 
all-nighter...
